description: PAID. Costs one interval of the first machine in the door's ranking that runs it within this server's cap (hosts set their own price; 0.007 USDC an hour today; see charter_offers), paid from this server's own wallet in USDC on Base. Hosts are run by independent operators, not vetted by Charter. Opens a Linux box of your own (Debian, 1 CPU, 1 GiB memory, the offer's home.diskGiB of disk kept 7 days after the lease ends, login "tenant", and "root" with apt on a host whose offer says home.root) and pays its first interval. The host's operator can read its disk. Pass 1 to 8 SSH PUBLIC keys; the key set is the home's identity, so the same keys open the same disk again. Read this before renting: SSH is plain: ssh -p <port> tenant@<host> to the public address the lease shows, no special client needed (some hosts publish an onion address on the Anyone network instead, which needs an Anyone client); outbound traffic may be slow; homes are limited (home.slots in the offer) and an open answers busy when they are full. After renting, call charter_lease about once a minute until it shows the SSH address, and charter_extend before the paid time runs out.
